_comment: The one table every binding's test of its retired-message function reads (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §2, "A retired repository"; public issue #571). Each case is one 410 body, as the bytes the fetch layer read (body_text encoded as UTF-8, or body_hex), and the message the function must return: a string, or null for no message. The rule: if the body is JSON and errors[0].message is a string, every code point in U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+200E, U+200F, U+202A-U+202E and U+2066-U+2069 is removed, the rest is cut to 256 code points with U+2026 appended when it was cut, and an empty result is no message. Nothing else is changed.

cases.name: contract-body
cases.why: the registry's own 410 body (measured on staging chtypes/v1, 2026-10-07): errors[0].message, verbatim
cases.body_text: {"errors":[{"code":"DENIED","message":"chtypes/v1 is retired: use chtypes/v2 (this registry no longer serves chtypes/v1)","detail":{"retired":"chtypes/v1","successor":"chtypes/v2"}}]}
cases.message: chtypes/v1 is retired: use chtypes/v2 (this registry no longer serves chtypes/v1)

cases.name: c0-escape-sequence
cases.why: an ANSI escape sequence: ESC (U+001B) is removed, the printable rest is kept

cases.name: c0-controls
cases.why: U+0000 to U+001F are removed, tab, newline and carriage return included

cases.name: del-and-c1
cases.why: U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F are removed

cases.name: bidi-override
cases.why: a bidirectional override and its pop are removed

cases.name: bidi-marks-embeddings-isolates
cases.why: U+200E, U+200F, U+202A to U+202E and U+2066 to U+2069 are removed

cases.name: neighbors-kept
cases.why: the code points just outside each removed range are kept, and so is every other character

cases.name: spaces-kept
cases.why: nothing is trimmed: leading, trailing and repeated spaces stay

cases.name: over-cap-300
cases.why: 300 code points: cut to 256, then U+2026 appended

cases.name: exactly-256
cases.why: 256 code points: not cut, no ellipsis
257 code points: cut to 256, then U+2026 appended

cases.name: non-bmp-is-the-256th
cases.why: the 256th code point is U+1F600 (two UTF-16 units, four UTF-8 bytes): it is kept whole and the rest is cut

cases.name: non-bmp-exactly-256
cases.why: 255 ASCII and one U+1F600 are 256 code points (257 UTF-16 units): not cut

cases.name: non-bmp-raw-utf8
cases.why: the same character sent as raw UTF-8 rather than an escape

cases.name: combining-marks-count
cases.why: a combining mark is its own code point: 200 e + U+0301 pairs are 400 code points

cases.name: cut-after-removal
cases.why: the cap counts what is left after removal: 50 removed and 250 kept is not cut

cases.name: sanitized-and-capped
cases.why: the conformance case retired-410-sanitized: an escape sequence, a bidi override and a message past 256 code points

cases.name: empty-string
cases.why: an empty message is no message

cases.name: only-removed-characters
cases.why: a message that is empty once sanitized is no message

cases.name: message-number
cases.why: a message that is not a string is no message

cases.name: message-null
cases.why: a null message is no message

cases.name: message-object
cases.why: an object message is no message

cases.name: message-array
cases.why: an array message is no message

cases.name: no-message-key
cases.why: an error with no message is no message

cases.name: message-key-case
cases.why: the key is message, exactly: Message is another key

cases.name: only-the-first-error
cases.why: only errors[0] is read

cases.name: duplicate-message-key
cases.why: a repeated key: the last one is the value, as every binding's own JSON reader gives it

cases.name: errors-empty
cases.why: an empty errors array is no message

cases.name: errors-not-an-array
cases.why: errors must be an array

cases.name: first-error-not-an-object
cases.why: errors[0] must be an object

cases.name: no-errors-key
cases.why: a JSON object without errors is no message

cases.name: json-null
cases.why: the JSON value null is no message

cases.name: json-array
cases.why: a top-level array is no message

cases.name: json-string
cases.why: a top-level string is no message

cases.name: not-json
cases.why: a plain-text body is no message

cases.name: nan-literal
cases.why: NaN is not JSON, so the body is no message even where a reader would accept it

cases.name: truncated-json
cases.why: a body cut short is not JSON, so no message

cases.name: trailing-garbage
cases.why: JSON followed by more text is not JSON

cases.name: trailing-whitespace
cases.why: whitespace around the JSON is allowed
cases.body_text: {"errors":[{"code":"DENIED","message":"chtypes/v1 is retired: use chtypes/v2 (this registry no longer serves chtypes/v1)","detail":{"retired":"chtypes/v1","successor":"chtypes/v2"}}]}
cases.message: chtypes/v1 is retired: use chtypes/v2 (this registry no longer serves chtypes/v1)

cases.name: empty-body
cases.why: an empty body is no message

cases.name: utf8-bom
cases.why: a UTF-8 byte order mark before the JSON makes it not JSON

cases.name: invalid-utf8
cases.why: a body that is not UTF-8 is no message

cases.name: raw-control-in-string
cases.why: an unescaped control character inside a JSON string makes it not JSON

cases.name: lone-surrogate-escape
cases.why: a lone UTF-16 surrogate escape is not a Unicode string, so no message

cases.name: lone-trail-surrogate-escape
cases.why: a lone trailing surrogate escape, likewise

cases.name: surrogate-pair-escape
cases.why: a surrogate pair escape is one code point
